title: Forward-Backward McKean-Vlasov System with Jumps and a Monotone Source With à Control-Shifted Interface : Well-Posedness, Stability, and Yosida Rates
summary: We study a forward-backward McKean-Vlasov system with jumps and one-way coupling: the forward equation is independent of the backward variables, whereas the BSDE depends on the forward state and its law. A source generated by a maximal monotone operator is evaluated along the forward state and then accumulated in the backward equation. The operator is the subdifferential of a convex potential evaluated at the state translated by a function of the control, plus a term depending on the law of the state, so the control shifts the discontinuity interface of its minimal-norm selection.
